Company.title: Company Profile
Company.description: An MCA company or LLP registration profile being tracked, along with its specific filing statuses and custom event forms.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner of this company profile

capital.description: Paid-up capital or contribution amount in INR

isSmall.description: Whether the company is classified as a Small Company

lastAGMDate.description: Date of the last held AGM (YYYY-MM-DD)

llpLastForm11Date.description: Last filed date for LLP Form 11 (YYYY-MM-DD)

llpLastForm8Date.description: Last filed date for LLP Form 8 (YYYY-MM-DD)

filedStatus.description: Key-value map of form identifiers and their filing statuses

customForms.description: Array of additional/custom event-based filings configured for the company

savedAt.description: Date-time string when the profile was saved

MCANotification.title: MCA Official Notification
MCANotification.description: An official circular, notification, or order published by the MCA, synced in real-time.

title.description: Title of the circular or notification

category.description: Sub-category like Company Law, LLP, Insolvency

description.description: Comprehensive summary or full text of circular

docRef.description: Form number or Gazette ID referenced

important.description: Whether this notification requires urgent reader action

/companies/{companyId}.description: Global collection containing all saved user company compliance records

/mca_notifications/{notificationId}.description: Real-time feed of official Ministry of Corporate Affairs updates and circulars
